title: DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository (UC model Files API): downloads stay single-stream and list_artifacts returns [] for files or missing paths
answers: Downloading a large Unity Catalog model file via the Files API is slow or ignores the chunk size setting; why?
Listing artifacts of a UC model version returns nothing or errors when the path is a single file or does not exist; how is it handled?
Where do model files under /Models/<catalog>/<schema>/<model>/<version> get listed, uploaded or downloaded through WorkspaceClient().files?
Where is the single-stream versus parallel presigned download decision made for cloud artifact repos?
body:
Path: mlflow/store/artifact/databricks_sdk_models_artifact_repo.py:DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository handles list_artifacts, log_artifact, _upload_to_cloud and _download_from_cloud for files under /Models/<catalog>/<schema>/<model>/<version>, using WorkspaceClient().files. The download/upload guard lives in mlflow/store/artifact/cloud_artifact_repo.py:CloudArtifactRepository._download_file.
Rule: _download_file must take the single-stream _download_from_cloud branch for this repo, because it has no presigned URLs for the parallel multipart path. The guard compares type(self).__name__ to "DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository". Download streams in MLFLOW_MULTIPART_DOWNLOAD_CHUNK_SIZE chunks (default 100 MB). list_artifacts first calls _is_dir, which catches databricks.sdk.errors.platform.NotFound from get_directory_metadata, and returns [] for a file or missing directory instead of raising.
Constraints: The guard matches on class name as a string, so renaming the class or adding a subclass silently disables the single-stream exception. The SDK import is lazy, so the module loads without databricks-sdk being imported at package import time.
applies: Changing list, upload or download behavior of the Files-API-backed UC model artifact repo, or the cloud artifact download branching it relies on.
says: Downloading large model files from the catalog takes too long without parallel transfer.
The model version artifact browser displays an empty list when clicking a single file.
Catalog model artifact listing returns no files when opening a missing folder path.
Enable parallel multipart download streams when retrieving large model files from the catalog.
search: In DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository (handling list_artifacts, log_artifact, _upload_to_cloud, and _download_from_cloud under /Models/<catalog>/<schema>/<model>/<version>), CloudArtifactRepository._download_file forces single-stream downloads in MLFLOW_MULTIPART_DOWNLOAD_CHUNK_SIZE chunks by comparing type(self).__name__ to 'DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository', as presigned URLs for parallel multipart downloads are unavailable. For directory listings, list_artifacts calls _is_dir, which catches databricks.sdk.errors.platform.NotFound from get_directory_metadata and returns [] for a single file or missing directory instead of raising. Subclassing or renaming the repository class silently breaks the single-stream guard, and databricks-sdk is imported lazily at runtime.
